notes: UPS service level indicators -- bytes 9 and 10 of an 18-character 1Z tracking
number, read only after the number's format and check digit have passed.
This is a fourth vocabulary, and it is NOT UPS's API service code list. The two
agree on every domestic service and disagree on every international one:
service               indicator   API service code
Worldwide Saver       04          65
Worldwide Express     66          07
Worldwide Expedited   67          08
Standard              68          11
That partial overlap is the hazard, and it is worse than no overlap: a table
built from UPS's published API codes looks confirmed on the five domestic
services and is then silently wrong on all four international ones. Note in
particular that 04, 66, 67 and 68 are NOT the API codes 65, 07, 08 and 11, and
that reading an API code as an indicator resolves to nothing here by design.
Three of the international indicators run contiguously and 04 sits apart, so the
block is not a sequence to extrapolate along. Every row below is an observed
pair; a neighbouring code is not evidence.
An indicator absent from this table falls through to unknown. So does a
non-numeric one we have no evidence for: a Y-prefix is not assumed to be a
family, because YN has been seen on a label whose service is not known.
Service names are PolyBag catalog names, matching CarrierSeeder, because the
service value is a name and not a code.

provenance.source: observed tracking-number/service pairs, not published by UPS
observed_on: A 3PL's production shipment history, grouped by service against bytes 9-10.
Roughly 20 years of shipments, so the long tail carries hand-typed tracking
numbers and hand-picked service labels and is not clean. Only the high-count
pairs are taken from it, and YW was additionally checked in the other
direction: 10495 shipments carry YW and every one of them is SurePost.
Shopify-bought test labels, where the service is known because the purchase
asked for it, each number verified against the check digit: Ground Saver
1Z28X87GYW27798425 (which also prints the plaintext UPS GROUND SAVER),
Worldwide Expedited 1Z28X87G6713238443, and Standard labels to Canada
corroboration: Every row carries two independent sources except 68.
The five domestic indicators coincide with UPS's own API service codes.
All four international indicators -- 04, 66, 67, 68 -- were read off the
production history first and then returned independently by Shopify-bought
labels for the same services. Two unrelated systems, decades apart, agreeing
on values that appear in no UPS documentation.
YW rests on the production history's reverse check plus the self-labelling
68 rests on Shopify-bought Standard labels alone -- a single source, but a
controlled purchase whose service was known, which is a different quality of
evidence from the production history's hand-entered tail.
